title: Refund Windows, Methods and Floors on the Employee Meal Account
content:
A till transaction rung on an Employee Meal Account may be refunded within the window its meal plan prints, by the method that plan prints, and only above the floor that plan prints. The three figures are set out here for all six plans of the line.

| Meal plan | Refund may be asked for within | Refund is returned | Smallest amount refunded |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | 7 calendar days | to the card originally used | $1.00 |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | 14 calendar days | to stored value | $1.00 |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | 14 calendar days | through payroll | $1.00 |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | 10 calendar days | to stored value | $1.00 |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | 7 calendar days | to stored value | $1.00 |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | 30 calendar days | through payroll | $5.00 |

## Definitions

The refund window is the calendar days after a till transaction within which a refund may be asked for. The refund method is where a refund is returned — to stored value, through payroll, or to the card originally used. The refund floor is the smallest amount the plan refunds.

## Comparison across the line

The windows run 7, 14, 14, 10, 7 and 30 calendar days in plan order. The floor is $1.00 on five of the six plans and $5.00 on the Executive Dining Charge Account. Method is where the plans differ most: the Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account returns a refund to the card originally used; the Prepaid Declining Balance Account, the Subsidized Daily Allowance Account and the Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account return it to stored value; the Payroll Deduction Meal Account and the Executive Dining Charge Account return it through payroll.
